exposure: intrathecal hyperbaric bupivacaine 12.5 mg plus 0.5 mL saline
intrathecal hyperbaric bupivacaine 12.5 mg plus 1 mg nalbuphine
intrathecal hyperbaric bupivacaine 12.5 mg plus 2.5 mg midazolam
outcome: onset and duration of sensory block
onset and duration of motor block
cohort: The study included 90 females undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Adding 1 mg nalbuphine to 12.5 mg hyperbaric bupivacaine provided more effective postoperative analgesia than adding 2.5 mg midazolam, with fewer adverse effects in the midazolam group, for patients undergoing elective cesarean section.
followup_time: Up to approximately 4.4 hours post-surgery for effective analgesic time and block regression
